name: Relicborn
summary: Brightly painted skeleton-folk of Kalero's tombs, who party instead of sleeping, dance into battle and lend a failing friend a last push.

traits.name: Dance of Death
traits.summary: Bonus Action: DC 15 Charisma (Performance or an instrument) check. Success: Advantage on your next attack roll this turn. Beat the DC by 5 or more: also roll a Hit Point Die (not spent) for that many Temporary Hit Points.
traits.text: As a Bonus Action you make a DC 15 Charisma check using Performance or a Musical Instrument. If you succeed, the next attack roll you make before the end of your turn has Advantage. If you succeed by 5 or more, you can also roll one of your Hit Point Dice (without expending it) and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the number rolled.

traits.name: Eternal Party
traits.summary: You don't need to sleep; a Long Rest takes 4 hours spent in revelry (stories, music).
traits.text: You do not need to sleep, and you can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours enjoying revelry such as telling stories or playing music. Unlike a trance this does not make you immune to magical sleep.

traits.name: Moment of Remembrance
traits.summary: Reaction when another creature you see within 30 feet fails a D20 Test: it adds 1d4 to the total. Once that turns a failure into a success, it is spent until a Short or Long Rest.
traits.text: When another creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to let it add 1d4 to the total, possibly making it succeed. The use is spent only when this trait turns a failed roll into a success; once it has, you cannot use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Soul of Revelry
traits.summary: Proficiency in Performance or with one Musical Instrument.
traits.text: You gain proficiency in the Performance skill or with one kind of Musical Instrument (your choice).

options.name: Musical Instrument
options.summary: Proficiency with one kind of Musical Instrument.
